### ST-019

**Runtime environment scan**

*As a **developer**, I want **SmartTest to detect OS, CPU, memory, Node version and permissions**, so that **it can choose sane worker counts and warn about unsupported runtimes**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 3 | S1 | B01, §5.3 | [ST-001](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-001) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Returns OS, arch, Node version, CPU count, free memory and writable state of the project root
- [x] Unsupported Node versions produce an actionable diagnostic
- [x] Environment variables are only read from an allow-list; values never logged

---

### ST-020

**Package manager and workspace detection**

*As a **developer in a monorepo**, I want **npm, pnpm and Yarn projects and their workspaces to be detected**, so that **SmartTest understands package boundaries**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S1 | B02, §3.3 | [ST-005](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-005) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Detects npm/pnpm/Yarn (classic & berry) from lockfiles and `packageManager`
- [x] Lists workspace packages with names, paths and internal dependencies
- [x] Conflicting lockfiles produce a warning, not a guess

---

### ST-021

**Framework detection with evidence**

*As a **developer**, I want **React, Next.js, Express, NestJS and plain Node libraries recognised**, so that **recommendations fit my stack**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S1 | B03, §3.3 | [ST-020](DET-project-detection.md#st-020) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Each detected framework lists its evidence (manifest dep, config file, import)
- [x] Unknown frameworks don't block detection; the project is treated as generic Node
- [x] Detection results match `expected.json` for every fixture

### ST-022

**Test runner and test convention detection**

*As a **QA engineer**, I want **Jest/Vitest, their configs, test file patterns, setup files and placement conventions detected**, so that **SmartTest reuses what already exists**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S1 | B04, B06, §5.3 | [ST-020](DET-project-detection.md#st-020) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Detects Jest and Vitest including config files and per-workspace configs
- [x] Infers placement convention (mirror / colocated / mixed) with ratios
- [x] Lists fixtures, mocks and setup files without modifying them

### ST-023

**Source layout and import alias analysis**

*As a **developer**, I want **source roots, entry points, generated dirs and path aliases detected**, so that **analysis covers the right files**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S2 | B05, §5.3 | [ST-020](DET-project-detection.md#st-020) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Reads `tsconfig` paths/baseUrl, package `exports`/`imports` and bundler aliases where statically declared
- [x] Proposes include/exclude globs; generated/build dirs excluded by default
- [x] Ambiguities are reported as warnings with evidence

### ST-024

**Version control detection**

*As a **developer**, I want **Git, nested repositories and no-VCS projects detected**, so that **the right change source is chosen automatically**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 2 | S1 | B07, §7.8 | [ST-001](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-001) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] SVN/Mercurial/Perforce markers are detected and reported as 'not supported in 1.0'
